description:
Poppy Pepper just wants to survive junior high and avoid her rich rival, Saffron Longfellow, and her brownie-baking minions, The Lady Rangers. But when mysterious new girl Cassia Caraway arrives, she teams up with Poppy and together they plot to bring Saffron and crew down.

Note: The digital edition (1/26/2015) for this issue was released before the print edition.

issue_title: Winter, Chapter Four: 350 Degrees of Separation
description: Winter, Part 4: “350 Degrees of Separation” - Poppy and Cassia made a helluva team, but that bond has been broken, perhaps irrevocably. With winter break upon them and Cassia returning home to Connecticut for the holidays, will time apart heal their wounds... or aggravate them?

Winter, Part 5: “Kneadful Things” - An alliance forms between a pair of one-time rivals, but can they restore the Patty Cakes empire before tearing each other to pieces? Poppy wants no part of it, and turns to a sympathetic ear for advice. But she might not like what she hears.

issue_title: Winter, Conclusion: Thyme Can't Heal Some Wounds
description: Winter, Conclusion: “Thyme Can't Heal Some Wounds” - Cassia's alliance ends not with claws out, but via a surprising escape clause. Ginger has a breakthrough in her investigation, though Anise still harbors a few doubts. And after an intense talk with Marjorie, Poppy weighs if she's truly moved on from the Patty Cakes

issue_title: Spring, Chapter One: Can't Stand the Heat
description: Spring, Chapter One: “Can't Stand the Heat” - Poppy and Cassia are reunited, but why doesn't it feel so good? The pieces of Cassia's master plan are falling into place, and even intrepid investigators Ginger and Anise are starting to believe it. That is until Marjorie makes a decision that threatens to scatter those pieces anew.

Spring, Finale: “The Good Dine Young” - Arrested? Arrested. Poppy and Cassia are hauled into the Ridge Reach Police Department for questioning and neither of them could have seen this turn of events. Now, their friendship—if ever they were truly friends—will be tested like never before. Will they be sent away for good, or is there one last card they can play to get out of this mess?

issue_title: Spring, Finale: The Good Dine Young
description: Spring, Finale: “The Good Dine Young” - Surprisingly, Cassia and Poppy walked out of the police station unscathed but not unchanged, their partnership irrevocably shattered. School journalist Anise documents the fallout not just between them but among their small community in the wake of the Patty Cakes empire's fall. For her, for Ginger, for Saffron, Marjorie, Cassia, and Poppy, the world is a very different place now.

After some initial trepidation, Poppy takes her first step on the dark side, deciding to go through with Cassia's plan to sabotage rival Saffron's Brownie Brawl fundraiser—and Saffron's chances with local heartthrob Bobby Benson—using some strategically-placed baked goods, and just a dash of malice.

Note: The digital edition (2/25/2015) for this issue was released before the print edition.

issue_title: Fall, Chapter Three: What Girls Are Made Of
description:
Bobby Benson and friends devour Poppy and Cassia's illicit brownies and find they have a completely different effect than any of them expected. Meanwhile, Poppy learns something sobering about the nutmeg they used. Will it be enough for her to quit the game?

Note: The digital edition (4/1/2015) for this issue was released before the print edition.

Fall, Part 4: “The Bake Sale.” It's the Lady Rangers' Brownie Brawl Kickoff and Vista Vale is hopping. Teen detective Ginger and school paper editor Anise are there, hunting for a new case. Meanwhile, Poppy learns more about Cassia as they seek a new ally for their secret brownie enterprise.

Poppy and Cassia, the teen masterminds behind the addictive Patty Cake brownies, hoping to better understand their product, violate one of the 10 Crime Commandments: they try their own supply.

Note: The digital edition (10/7/2015) for this issue was released before the print edition.

Fall, Part 6: "Patty Cakes" As Poppy and Cassia's criminally delicious brownies spread among Vista Vale schools, they catch the attention of teen detective Ginger and teen journalist Anise. Meanwhile, Poppy's appetite for those same brownies and their mind-bending effects only increases.

Winter, Part 1:“Spice Racketeers.” There's a chill in the air. Saffron is still queen bee, but her throne is unstable. Marjorie has some new friends. Ginger and Anise have nearly uncovered the mysterious “Patty” and “Patricia.” And things are less than peachy between our criminal bakers Poppy and Cassia. Seasons change, mad things rearrange

issue_title: Winter, Chapter Two: Elle Veut Le Beurre Et L'Argent Du Beurre
description:
Winter, Part 2: “Elle Veut Le Beurre Et L'Argent Du Beurre”

Saffron's power is waning, but nature abhors a vacuum, and Cassia, with Poppy in tow,

is aiming for her spot. Meanwhile, Ginger and Anise are closing in on the Patty Cakes, Marjorie's a wild card, and Saffron has one last play left.

Note: The indicia for this issue lists the wrong issue number (#7 instead of #8) and possibly the wrong published month, it lists March.

Winter, Part 3:“Chocolatears” - With her friends gone and nothing left to lose, Saffron makes Cassia an offer she can't refuse: she wants in on the Patty Cakes enterprise. And poor Poppy, drifting for weeks unnoticed by her best friend, finally gives in completely to her secret brownie addiction.

description: With the McGuffin device now in the hands of Cobra, G.I.Joe must attack Destro's Castle head on to retrieve it! Snake-Eyes, Duke, Scarlett, Stalker, and the gang face off against Destro, Baroness, Cobra Commander, Billy, and Dr. Mindbender. Even worse, the Jugglers refuse to answer any Joe pleas for help.

description: A running firefight through Destro's personal castle leads to crosses and double crosses. Worse, the Joes' transport home has exploded.

issue_title: Icebound; Part 1 of 4 - A Day in the Life
description: Duke leads a Joe team to investigate a scientific installation. Only problem is, last time he led a team in this very place, he was the only survivor.

"Icebound" Part two, Trapped inside an isolated arctic base, Duke, Snake Eyes, Scarlett, Frostbite, Lifeline and Airtight not only realize they're not alone, but also begin to understand the nature of the savage, genetically-corrupted creatures haunting the base's corridors. And just when they thought it couldn't get any weirder, a threat previously frozen starts to thaw... The sub-zero thrills continue in G.I. Joe: Icebound.
The team is seperated deep in the Arctic base. Humanoid beasts are on the rampage and their very touch could mean death.

issue_title: Icebound; Part 4 of 4 - Run for Daylight
description: Duke tries to save his team and innocent bystander from a rampaging horde of humanoid beasts. But it might be too late for any of them...

The origin of ZANYA finally told! Raised by a harsh and thoughtless mother, young Zanya has always had to fend for herself. So when she learns her father is none other than the leader of the Dreadnoks, she hits the road in search of a new life with the father she never knew. But will the road prove to be too harsh for her to travel?  After traveling across the country tracking down the Dreadnoks, Zanya and her older boyfriend Kevin finally meet up with the elusive biker gang in Kansas City. To gain admission to the rough and tough gang, fourteen year old Zanya must hold her own in a biker brawl while Kevin stands idly by, flirting with danger.
